description: This file defines the TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter class which implements buffer writing functionality for testing serialization components in Orleans. It manages a list of byte segments, provides methods to obtain memory spans, advance the buffer, and retrieve committed data as sequences.

classes.name: TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter
classes.description: A testing buffer writer that manages multiple byte segments, allowing for advancing, obtaining memory, and reading back the committed data as sequences.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current buffer by the specified number of bytes, saving the committed data.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> of at least the specified size, creating a new buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> of at least the specified size, creating a new buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> representing all committed buffers up to the specified maximum segment size.

methods.name: PeekAllBuffers
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> of all committed buffers including the current buffer.
